chatSettings.checkTitle: Check the service again with the saved configuration
chatSettings.searxngHint: The Docker image listens on 8080 inside the container, the same port as llama-server: the usual mapping is -p 8888:8080.
chatSettings.apiKeyNoteBefore: The API key is read from the environment variable
chatSettings.apiKeyNoteAfter: . It is not edited here so it does not end up written in config.json.
chatSettings.maxRoundsHint: Cap on the back-and-forth between the model and the tools within a single response.
chatSettings.allowPrivateHint: The fetch_url URL is chosen by the model, not by you. A manipulated search result could direct it to a service on your network. Enable it only if you want it to read internal documentation.
chatSettings.engineHintBrowser: The browser transcribes. In Chrome the audio goes to Google servers, and the API does not exist inside the desktop package.
chatSettings.engineHintWhisper: Local transcription with faster-whisper. Nothing leaves the machine.
chatSettings.engineHintAuto: Uses the browser engine if available and falls back to local Whisper otherwise. That is what is needed for it to work both in the browser and in the desktop package.
chatSettings.whisperInstalled: faster-whisper installed — first use downloads ~{{mb}} MB
chatSettings.whisperLanguageHint: Empty = auto detection. If you always dictate in the same language, fixing it improves accuracy.
chatSettings.maxTextCharsHint: The extracted text is stored inside the message, so this also limits how much the database grows.
chatSettings.imageTokensHint: Only for the context notice before sending. The real cost varies a lot between vision models.

launcher.templateNamePlaceholder: Name to save as a template…

launcher.faQuantsWarning: ⚠ With flash_attn=on the KV cache must be symmetric and be q4_0/q4_0, q8_0/q8_0, f16/f16 or bf16/bf16 (the build FA_QUANTS).
launcher.loadModeHint: Replaces mlock/mmap: how the binary loads the model file (--load-mode).
launcher.mtpEmbeddedHint: The model already ships the MTP head: it does not need a separate file.
launcher.draftKvHint: q8_0 saves ~50% of the draft VRAM vs the llama-server f16 default.
launcher.draftFaQuantsWarning: ⚠ The draft KV also falls under FA_QUANTS: with flash_attn=on, k and v must be equal (or both Automatic). The backend rejects the launch if they differ.
launcher.visionEmbeddedHint: This model has the vision encoder built in: it does not need a separate mmproj.
launcher.visionDetectedHint: This model has an mmproj detected in the scan.
launcher.thinkingTitleNoKwarg: This model's template does not use enable_thinking
launcher.thinkingTitleUnsupported: This model does not support thinking

launcher.thinkingUnsupportedNote: This model does not support thinking.
launcher.ollamaNoReasoning: ⚠ Ollama does not support reasoning_effort or native chat templates.
launcher.budgetTokensNote: Sent as --reasoning-budget (only with thinking enabled; if reasoning_budget is set explicitly, it wins).
launcher.jinjaNote: Only llama-server with --jinja. Not compatible with Ollama.
launcher.noReasoningPreserveNote: Preserves the reasoning on every turn by default (costs extra tokens); enabling it adds --no-reasoning-preserve.
launcher.reasoningBudgetNote: Native server token budget (--reasoning-budget). Controls the reasoning on every request, not only with thinking enabled.
launcher.ggufMetaError: Could not read the GGUF metadata: {{error}}
launcher.ctxOverflowWarning: ⚠ n_ctx ({{nCtx}}) exceeds the model's native context ({{native}})
launcher.vramNoFit: Does not fit in the GPU VRAM: try a lower quantization, a smaller n_ctx, or MoE offload to CPU.
launcher.vramJustFit: It fits, but right at the limit: consider reducing n_ctx or using fit_target.
launcher.vramUnknown: Declare your GPU's VRAM in Configuration to find out if it fits.
launcher.vramMoE: MoE: the weights are the total parameters (only the active ones run per token).
launcher.kvParallelWarning: ⚠ With n_parallel > 1 and kv_unified off, each slot reserves its own full KV cache (x{{n}} the context VRAM).
launcher.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave empty to not require auth
launcher.defragDeprecatedHint: Marked DEPRECATED in the binary's --help; the backend still sends it for now.
launcher.ctxCheckpointsHint: Max context checkpoints per slot (~150 MiB of VRAM each). Build default: 32.
launcher.checkpointMinStepHint: Minimum spacing between checkpoints (tokens). Build default: 8192.
launcher.cacheRamHint: Limit of the prompt cache in system RAM (0 = disabled).
launcher.fitTargetHint: VRAM margin to reserve per device (0 = off).
launcher.kvUnifiedPerSlotHint: Context per slot with kv_unified active (0 = unlimited, uses n_ctx).
launcher.sleepIdleHint: Idle seconds until the server frees VRAM (0 = off).
launcher.lazyModeHint: On-demand reading of large tensors (auto = only >4GiB).
